verdict.rationale: Render documents built-in infrastructure metrics from day zero, including CPU and memory metrics, with telemetry streaming to external tools. This covers part of the 'site performance' side of the story, but nothing in the evidence shows visitor-behavior or web analytics such as page views, visitors, or referrers. missing for 10: visitor/web analytics, request-level site performance metrics (latency, response times), detailed metrics docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can track site performance and visitor behavior with built-in analytics
